cards.card_text: The children call out, "We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn." Friend, that's me baking chocolate chip, then sprinkles, then butterscotch, and the SAME guy won't touch ANY of it, so at some point...
cards.verse_text: ‘We played the flute for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
